name: TWINKLE TWINKLE LIQUOR STAR
source:
Twinkle twinkle liquor star

How I wonder how drunk you are

Tucked away from the party I sigh

Why'd I fall hard for a straight guy?

You know how this story ends, and it doesn't end well. 

[From [url=https://runicrunner.itch.io/twinkle-twinkle-liquor-star]Itch.io[/url]]
